# **Project Overview**

The **"Chokro: Circular Economy and E-Waste Management System"** is a web and mobile platform designed to bridge the gap between individual households, verified recycling partners, and platform administrators. The system manages three main user roles: Individual Users, Verified Partners (collectors, recyclers, NGOs), and System Administrators. It facilitates item listing, smart AI-assisted disposal recommendations, drop-zone deposits, pickup scheduling, and a loyalty reward program backed by a verified credit wallet and notification system.

### **Tech Stack:**

* **Language:** TypeScript, JavaScript
* **Framework:** Next.js (Admin & API), React Native / Expo (Mobile App)
* **Styling:** TailwindCSS, NativeWind
* **Database:** PostgreSQL
* **ORM:** Prisma
* **Deployment:** Vercel
* **External APIs:**  
  * **OpenAI / Gemini API:** For AI item classification and next-life path recommendation.  
  * **bKash API:** For processing credit reward redemptions and cash-outs.  
  * **Gmail / Push Notification API:** For sending transaction updates and pickup alerts.

---

# **User Roles**

1. # **Individual User:**  
   The primary consumer users — they can register, manage profiles, list unwanted items, use the AI assistant for item valuation, choose disposal paths, deposit items at campus Drop Zones, schedule pickups, earn reward points, and redeem credits to bKash.

2. # **Verified Partner:**  
   A verified business or organization — they can manage their organization profile, list operational service areas, view assigned collection tasks, place binding offers on recyclable materials, and complete two-sided QR handshakes during item pickup.

3. # **Admin:**  
   A system super-user — responsible for verifying partner organization registrations (including DoE e-waste licenses), maintaining published rate cards, managing Drop Zone collection points, resolving escalated verifications, and moderating system activity.

# **Functional Requirements**

### **Common Workflows**

| SL | Common Workflows |
| :---- | :---- |
| 1 | **Registration and Login System**: Users can create an account by providing basic details such as name, email, phone number, and password. Partner organizations complete a multi-step registration form including organization name, service areas, and license numbers for verification. Once registered, users and partners can log in securely to access their respective dashboards. |
| 2 | **Admin Role & Partner Verification Management**: An authorized administrator signs in to a dedicated panel to review pending partner applications, verify submitted credentials (e.g., organization license and e-waste permits), and approve or reject them. Only verified partners appear in searches and receive collection task assignments. |

### **Module 1 (Sprint 1: Core User, Listing & Pricing Systems)**

| Module 1 | |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Member** | **Feature Description** |
| **Member 1 (Sadat SKD)** | **User Profile & Partner Application System**: Individual users get a personal profile dashboard to manage account details and link to host campus institutions. Partner organizations complete a registration form with organization details, service locations, and license documentation so admins can verify eligibility before approving access. |
| **Member 2 (Ahmad Sameer)** | **Item Listing & Search Feed**: Users can create listings for unwanted items across 9 categories (such as clothes, books, plastics, and e-waste), specifying item details, condition, and quantity. Other users and partners can search and filter active listings by category, location, and condition. |
| **Member 3 (Sharzil Nafis)** | **Rate Card & Pricing Console**: Administrators get a central console to maintain baseline prices per kilogram or per piece across different categories and condition levels. This rate card is published in the app so users can see estimated item values transparently. |
| **Member 4 (Imran Ahmed Upom)** | **Reward Wallet & Collection Bins**: Users get a digital wallet to track earned Green Credit balances and view transaction history. Administrators can register campus Drop Zones and generate printable QR code posters to attach to physical collection bins. |

---

### **Module 2 (Sprint 2: Core Transactions & AI Recommendations)**

| Module 2 | |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Member** | **Feature Description** |
| **Member 1 (Sadat SKD)** | **Notification & Alert System**: Automatic notifications and email reminders keep users and partners updated at every step—from listing creation and pickup booking to credit verification and campus recycling drive announcements. |
| **Member 2 (Ahmad Sameer)** | **Circular Path Selection & Direct Requests**: Item owners can choose one of 5 disposal options (reuse, donate, repair, resell, or recycle) for their items and accept direct buy-now or collection requests from interested buyers and partner collectors. |
| **Member 3 (Sharzil Nafis)** | **AI Next-Life Assistant**: Users can upload a photo of an item to receive instant smart guidance that suggests the item's category, condition, estimated value, and best disposal path with a short, easy-to-understand explanation. |
| **Member 4 (Imran Ahmed Upom)** | **Drop Zone Deposit & Handshake Pickups**: Users can scan QR codes at physical Drop Zones to record item deposits. For scheduled home or campus pickups, givers and partner collectors complete a simple two-sided QR scan handshake at the time of pickup. |

---

### **Module 3 (Sprint 3: Verification, Financials & Compliance)**

| Module 3 | |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Member** | **Feature Description** |
| **Member 1 (Sadat SKD)** | **Dispute & Content Moderation**: Users can report fraudulent listings or bad behavior. Admins get a dedicated moderation panel to inspect reports, pause pending credit rewards, resolve disputes, and remove inappropriate content. |
| **Member 2 (Ahmad Sameer)** | **Recyclable Bidding & Pickup Scheduling**: Verified recycling partners can place single-round binding offers on recyclable items. Givers can accept an offer and confirm a mutually agreed pickup date and time. |
| **Member 3 (Sharzil Nafis)** | **Personal Impact Dashboard**: Users can track their environmental contribution over time through a clear dashboard showing total recycled weight, earned reward points, and estimated carbon footprint savings. |
| **Member 4 (Imran Ahmed Upom)** | **Verification Engine, Reward Cash-Out & E-Waste Protocol**: The system automatically verifies completed deposits and pickups to unlock reward credits, while routing suspicious transactions to admin review. Users can cash out verified credits to bKash, and e-waste items are strictly assigned to licensed recyclers. |

---

### **Module 4 (Sprint 4: Community Engagement & Platform Optimization)**

| Module 4 | |
| :---- | :---- |
| **Member** | **Feature Description** |
| **Member 1 (Sadat SKD)** | **Privacy Protection & Localization**: Sensitive location metadata is automatically stripped from uploaded photos. Users can request account data deletion, and primary platform actions are available in Bangla for local accessibility. |
| **Member 2 (Ahmad Sameer)** | **Completion & Two-Sided Review System**: After an item pickup or sale is finished, both givers and partners can rate each other (1 to 5 stars) and write short reviews, helping build community trust across the platform. |
| **Member 3 (Sharzil Nafis)** | **Community Leaderboards & Campaigns**: Displays leaderboards ranking top recycling individuals and campus institutions, while admins can launch special promotional campaigns offering bonus reward points during recycling drives. |
| **Member 4 (Imran Ahmed Upom)** | **Verification Queue Management**: Admins receive an efficient dashboard to review flagged transactions, perform random quality spot-checks, and adjust system verification settings to ensure smooth daily operations. |
